top_signals.title: Transparency data: HMT workforce management information: July 2026
top_signals.summary: This document details monthly management information on staff numbers and paybill costs within HM Treasury and its agencies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US approves possible $4.5 billion sale of KC-46As, equipment to Qatar
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Department of State approved a possible $4.5 billion Foreign Military Sale to Qatar for up to four KC-46As and related equipment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The U.S.-Canada natural gas and electricity trade value rose in 2025
top_signals.summary: Although the total value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau, the trade value of natural gas and electricity between the two countries increased slightly primarily because of increased natural gas prices and trade volume.
